You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a simple reusable barrier synchronization protocol for N processes. Each process starts in control state "b0" and may individually move to "b1"; once all processes are in "b1", the barrier resets all processes back to "b0" simultaneously. The specification defines the initial state, the next-state relation, a type correctness condition for the program counter function, and a temporal barrier property stating that a process cannot leave the barrier while some other process has not yet entered it.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds: N, Spec, TypeOK, BarrierProperty
